name: gaelan
description: Gaelan (Fall from Heaven), a wandering sorcerer hero: a lean young man with long wavy dark-auburn hair and sharp green eyes, a long deep teal-green travelling coat with copper-orange trim, copper buttons and flared skirts, a dark brown leather belt with pouches and a small book hanging at the hip, grey trousers, brown boots, a tall twisted dark-wood staff crowned with a big faceted cyan crystal held in copper prongs in his RIGHT hand, and a small solid cyan-white flame burning in the open palm of his LEFT hand
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays upright in his right hand on the screen-left side; his left hand on the screen-right side is held open, palm up, with the small cyan flame resting in it

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (staff arm thrown up and out to the left with the crystal staff upright, the open left hand flung out to the right, its small flame flickering)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crystal staff dipping, the open left hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up with the crystal staff, the open left hand drooping, its flame going out
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal staff lowering, the left hand empty
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff tipped down with its crystal end resting on the ground at the lower-right, left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crystal staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the long auburn hair flying
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the crystal staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the teal coat spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the teal coat settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crystal staff on the ground beside him, the flame gone
